  .interop-block { margin: 0 auto; max-width: 900px; }
  .interop-header { text-align:center; margin-bottom:28px; }
  .interop-badge {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FF6B2C,#FFB800);

  @keyframes dashFlow { from { stroke-dashoffset:40; } to { stroke-dashoffset:0; } }

    background:#ffffff; border:2px solid #0F1FA0; border-radius:16px;
    padding:14px 14px 10px; text-align:center; min-width:130px; max-width:160px;

  .engine-logo-img { width:110px; height:auto; display:block; }
  .engine-sub { font-size:.6rem; color:#0F1FA0; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; background:rgba(15,31,160,.07); border-radius:6px; padding:3px 7px; white-space:nowrap; }

  .interop-confirm { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:600; color:#00996e; background:rgba(0,200,150,.08); border-radius:8px; padding:7px 11px; animation:fadeInUp .4s ease both; min-width:150px; }
  .interop-confirm--2 { color:#090C9F; background:rgba(9,12,159,.06); animation-delay:.2s; }
  .interop-confirm i { font-size:.85rem; }
  @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
  .interop-group { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; }
  .interop-group-label { font-size:.65rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; margin-bottom:2px; align-self:flex-start; }
  .interop-group-label--instant { background:rgba(0,200,150,.1); color:#00896a; }
  .interop-group-label--bank { background:rgba(9,12,159,.07); color:#090C9F; }
  .interop-group-divider { border:none; border-top:1px dashed rgba(9,12,159,.12); margin:6px 0; }
  .interop-tags { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; justify-content:center; margin-top:16px; }
  .itag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; border-radius:20px; padding:4px 10px; border:1px solid transparent; }
  .itag--orange { background:rgba(255,107,44,.1); color:#c94f10; border-color:rgba(255,107,44,.25); }
  .itag--mtn    { background:rgba(255,203,5,.12);  color:#a07b00; border-color:rgba(255,203,5,.4); }
  .itag--airtel { background:rgba(220,30,30,.08);  color:#b01010; border-color:rgba(220,30,30,.2); }
  .itag--wave   { background:rgba(0,168,240,.1);   color:#006fa6; border-color:rgba(0,168,240,.25); }
  .itag--visa   { background:rgba(26,31,113,.08);  color:#1A1F71; border-color:rgba(26,31,113,.2); }
  @media(max-width:600px){
    .interop-schema { flex-direction:column; }
    .interop-arrows-wrap { width:100%; height:30px; transform:rotate(90deg); }
    .interop-center { flex-direction:row; }
    .interop-standalone-section { padding:40px 0 36px; }
  }

}</style><style id="ely-modals-css">
    @keyframes elyModalIn  { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(24px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
    @keyframes elyFadeIn   { from { opacity:0; } to { opacity:1; } }
    @keyframes elySpin     { to   { transform:rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes elySlideLeft{ from { opacity:0; transform:translateX(-16px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0); } }

    /* ── Overlay commun ── */
    .ely-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483647;
      background: rgba(4,5,45,0.82);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 16px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      animation: elyFadeIn 0.25s ease both;
    }
    .ely-overlay.open { display: flex; }

    /* ── Carte modale (split-screen simulé) ── */
    .ely-modal-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 900px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 96px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      animation: elyModalIn 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both;
      min-height: 560px;
      margin: auto;
    }

    /* ── Panneau gauche — branding ── */
    .ely-brand {
      background: linear-gradient(155deg, #090C9F 0%, #070980 40%, #05066B 75%, #07098a 100%);
      padding: 48px 44px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .ely-brand-grid {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 32px 32px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .ely-brand-orb1 {
      position: absolute; width: 420px; height: 420px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(9,12,159,0.6), transparent 70%);
      top: -160px; left: -160px; filter: blur(60px); pointer-events: none;
    }
    .ely-brand-orb2 {
      position: absolute; width: 300px; height: 300px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(227,91,52,0.3), transparent 70%);
      bottom: -100px; right: -60px; filter: blur(60px); pointer-events: none;
    }
    .ely-brand-sep {
      position: absolute; right: 0; top: 8%; bottom: 8%;
      width: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), transparent);
    }
    .ely-brand-logo { margin-bottom: 40px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .ely-brand-logo img {
      height: 38px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 10px;
    }
    .ely-brand-tagline {
      font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: #E35B34;
      margin-bottom: 16px; position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .ely-brand-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.18; margin-bottom: 18px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.7) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text; position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .ely-brand-title span {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E35B34, #FF7A50);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .ely-brand-desc {
      font-size: 0.88rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.7; max-width: 360px; margin-bottom: 36px;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }

    /* Features (login) */
    .ely-features { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .ely-feature  { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.84rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
    .ely-feat-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.85rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .efi-blue   { background: rgba(9,12,159,0.35); color: #7b9fff; border: 1px solid rgba(9,12,159,0.4); }
    .efi-orange { background: rgba(227,91,52,0.25); color: #FF7A50;  border: 1px solid rgba(227,91,52,0.3); }
    .efi-green  { background: rgba(0,200,150,0.2);  color: #00C896;  border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,150,0.3); }
    .efi-purple { background: rgba(130,80,255,0.2); color: #b388ff;  border: 1px solid rgba(130,80,255,0.3); }

    /* Étapes (register) */
    .ely-steps  { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .ely-step   { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
    .ely-step-num {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px;
    }
    .ely-step-num.active { background: #E35B34; border-color: #E35B34; }
    .ely-step-stitle { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .ely-step-sdesc  { font-size: 0.74rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.42); line-height: 1.5; }

    /* Perks */
    .ely-perks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 28px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .ely-perk  {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 4px 11px;
      font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    }
    .ely-perk i { color: #00C896; font-size: 0.65rem; }

    /* ── Panneau droit — formulaire ── */
    .ely-form-panel {
      background: #fff; padding: 44px 40px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
      position: relative; overflow-y: auto;
    }

    /* Bouton fermer */
    .ely-close {
      position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 18px;
      width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: #f0f2ff; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      color: #6b7494; font-size: 0.95rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; z-index: 10;
    }
    .ely-close:hover { background: #e0e3f0; color: #090C9F; }

    /* Sélecteur langue */
    .ely-lang {
      display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .ely-lang-btn {
      padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1.5px solid #e0e3f0; background: transparent;
      color: #8890b0; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }
    .ely-lang-btn:hover { background: #f0f2ff; color: #090C9F; border-color: #c5caee; }
    .ely-lang-btn.active { background: #090C9F; border-color: #090C9F; color: #fff; }

    /* En-tête formulaire */
    .ely-form-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 5px 14px;
      font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .ely-form-badge.orange { background: rgba(227,91,52,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(227,91,52,0.22); color: #E35B34; }
    .ely-form-badge.green  { background: rgba(0,200,150,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,150,0.25); color: #00956e; }
    .ely-form-title {
      font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 800; color: #070980;
      line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 7px;
    }
    .ely-form-sub { font-size: 0.82rem; color: #6b7494; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 24px; }

    /* Champs */
    .ely-field { margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .ely-label {
      display: block; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: #374060; margin-bottom: 7px; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .ely-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; }
    .ely-input-icon {
      position: absolute; left: 15px; color: #aab0cc;
      font-size: 0.82rem; pointer-events: none; transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .ely-input {
      width: 100%; padding: 13px 14px 13px 42px;
      background: #f7f8fc; border: 1.5px solid #e0e3f0;
      border-radius: 12px; color: #070980; font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .ely-input::placeholder { color: #b0b8d4; }
    .ely-input:focus {
      border-color: #090C9F; background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(9,12,159,0.08);
    }
    .ely-input:focus ~ .ely-input-icon,
    .ely-input-wrap:focus-within .ely-input-icon { color: #090C9F; }
    .ely-input.no-icon { padding-left: 14px; }
    .ely-input-eye {
      position: absolute; right: 12px; background: none; border: none;
      color: #aab0cc; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 4px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .ely-input-eye:hover { color: #090C9F; }

    /* Cadre info orange */
